crop.notes: The clipping starts at the deck headline; the section heading 'RING GOSSIP.' above it on the page is not included. The article body is complete.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch reported talk of a match between Tom Allen and Jem Mace, hinting that Allen planned a speculating tour of England, and that Arthur Chambers would stand trial in Illinois for seconding Allen against McCoole.

metadata.notes: Running head reads 'The Dispatch, Tuesday Evening, February 24, 1874'. Before 1878-12, so not the Post-Dispatch.

facts.fact: A match between Allen and Jem Mace was being talked of in sporting circles
Allen was hinted to be planning a speculating tour of his native England, the cause of the rumored Mace match
Arthur Chambers was coming to stand trial before the Illinois authorities for seconding Allen in his last fight with Mike McCoole

notes: A Dispatch reporter called at Allen's saloon but Allen was out; Jack Madden spoke instead. The rest of the column is other boxing news (Edwards-Collyer, O'Connor-Taylor).
